Good morning everyone, and thank you for joining the weekly planning meeting. The first item on the agenda is the supplier renewal. We reviewed the three offers last week, and the team agreed that the current supplier still gives us the best price and the most reliable delivery times. We will sign the renewal for another year before the end of the month. The second item is the office move. The new building will be ready in March, and every team needs to send a list of the equipment it wants to bring. Please send your list to the facilities group by Friday. The third item is the customer survey. The results were better than last year, but customers still find the ordering process too slow. We will ask two people from the support team to look at the most common complaints and suggest three changes. That is everything for today. The next meeting is on Tuesday at ten o'clock.
